ache.title: Another patch, another meta to chase
ache.note: Part 2 of Freezing Rush tweaks Azumarill, Blissey, Gardevoir, Lapras, Mega Mewtwo Y, Ceruledge and more. Two patches in a few weeks means the “best” picks keep moving, and chasing them keeps you checking in. You don’t have to keep up with every change to have a good match.
watch: checking every patch to keep up
ache.tip: Skim the patch for your own Pokémon and ignore the rest. You don’t have to keep up with every change.
lines: the meta moves. you can stay still
read your main’s line, close the tab
two patches in two weeks? breathe

videoData.title: Freezing Rush Part 2 Patch (Nov 1, 2024) | Pokémon Unite

textData.text: In this video, I dive into the newly released second part of the Freezing Rush patch for Pokemon Unite. We translate and analyze the latest patch notes, highlighting key changes and updates for various Pokemon including Azumarill, Blissey, Espeon, Gardevoir, Glaceon, Greedent, Lapras, Mega Mewtwo Y, Armarouge, Ceruledge, and others. I discuss the buffs and nerfs, and share my thoughts on how these changes might impact the current meta game. Join me as I plan to try out these updates in upcoming streams and give my personal take on the new patch.
